description: Create a new monitor. Provide at least name, url, and type. Returns the created monitor including its assigned id.

keyword.description: Keyword to assert for KEYWORD monitors.

method.description: HTTP method for HTTP/HTTPS monitors (default GET).

type.description: Monitor type: HTTP, HTTPS, KEYWORD, PING, PORT, DNS, SSL, VISUAL, CONTENT, API, GRAPHQL, WEBSOCKET.

url.description: Full URL to monitor (or hostname for PING/PORT/DNS/SSL).

name: vs_monitors_create
title: Create a monitor
